# Requirements Quality Checklist: Unified Agent Memory, Session Recall, and Documentation Enforcement

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurable acceptance across the full feature specification.
**Created**: 2026-08-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are requirements for all four governed shared-record classes explicitly differentiated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005a]
- [x] CHK002 - Are requirements defined for both clients, fresh sessions, and cross-client recall? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK003 - Are requirements for session capture and manual operator removal both documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK004 - Are documentation consultation, denial, activation, inspection, and emergency disablement requirements all present? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016–FR-023]
- [x] CHK005 - Are install-status and absent-component disposition requirements defined for every referenced flow-stack component? [Completeness, Spec §FR-024–FR-025]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 - Is “point of observation” defined precisely enough to distinguish an eligible record from a session note? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007a]
- [x] CHK007 - Are “shared knowledge,” “tool-local knowledge,” and “session recall” distinguished without overlap? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK008 - Are the required source pointer, date, origin, confidence, status, and provenance fields unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-011, §FR-011a]
- [x] CHK009 - Is “current reality” defined sufficiently to guide conflict verification? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006a]
- [x] CHK010 - Is “documentation available” defined by an objective receipt or service condition? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 - Do automatic write-through requirements remain consistent with the prohibition on bulk transcript promotion? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §FR-007a]
- [x] CHK012 - Do fail-closed secret requirements remain consistent with the requirement to index masked transcripts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014–FR-014b]
- [x] CHK013 - Do blocking enforcement requirements remain consistent with the internal-error behavior and viable path-through requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-018, §FR-019a, §FR-021]
- [x] CHK014 - Do the four record classes, status values, confidence levels, and conflict rules form one consistent lifecycle? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005a, §FR-006, §FR-006b]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 - Can the capture-effectiveness proportion be objectively sampled, calculated, and reported? [Measurability, Spec §FR-007b, §SC-008]
- [x] CHK016 - Are the “9 of 10 topics” recall target, relevance standard, and test population defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK017 - Is “fast enough to use mid-task” quantified with a latency threshold and measurement method? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK018 - Are success criteria explicitly distinguishable as met, unmet, or unmeasured? [Completeness, Spec §SC-001–SC-010]
- [x] CHK019 - Can zero blocked-without-path incidents be measured over a defined observation period? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario and Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK020 - Are primary, alternate, exception, recovery, and non-functional scenarios represented for shared records and recall? [Coverage, Spec §183–§234]
- [x] CHK021 - Are contradictory records preserved when neither side can be verified during the current session? [Recovery, Spec §FR-006–FR-006b]
- [x] CHK022 - Are duplicate writes, concurrent writers, and existing identifiers addressed without destructive overwrite? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK023 - Are empty, malformed, missing, and secret-bearing transcript inputs covered by explicit requirements? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-010a, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK024 - Are documentation-gate behavior and operator recovery specified when the docs service, territory file, or receipt is unavailable? [Recovery, Spec §FR-017–FR-023]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK025 - Are privacy and secret-handling requirements complete for source transcripts, projections, indexes, logs, and recall results? [Security, Spec §FR-014–FR-014c]
- [x] CHK026 - Are capture non-blocking behavior and recall freshness targets quantified? [Performance, Spec §FR-008, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK027 - Are storage growth, transcript retention, and aging requirements explicitly included or intentionally excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-010a]
- [x] CHK028 - Are operator inspection, deletion, rollback, and emergency-disable actions bounded by clear safety requirements? [Safety, Spec §FR-009, §FR-023]

## Dependencies, Assumptions, and Conflicts

- [x] CHK029 - Are assumptions about the existing watcher, documentation service, and both client integrations stated with validation criteria? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK030 - Is the boundary between workspace infrastructure requirements and repository-specific requirements explicit? [Scope, Spec §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK031 - Are unresolved flow-stack dispositions identified as decisions rather than silently treated as implementation work? [Dependency, Spec §FR-024–FR-026]
- [x] CHK032 - Are the documented deviations from technology-agnostic requirements intentional and consistently isolated to evidence sections? [Consistency, Spec §Why This Spec Exists, §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy review.
